prompt: Read nonnegative n; for i from 1 through n, add i*i only when i is divisible by 3; print the total plus 1.
target:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { IF (i%3==0) { total+=i*i. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).

prompt: Read nonnegative n. Start x at 1; repeat n times: double x and add 3. Print x.

NUMBER x=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<n, i++) { x=x*2+3. }
DISPLAYNL(x).

prompt: Read four pipe-delimited numbers. Keep values strictly greater than 1; add twice each kept value; print the result.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER total=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]>1) { total+=2*values[i]. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).
